title: Second Variation Formula for the Laplace Eigenvalue Functional on Closed Manifolds
summary: For a closed Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ of dimension $n$, let $λ_{1}(g)$ be the first positive eigenvalue of the Laplace--Beltrami operator $Δ_{g}$ and $\mbox{Vol}(M,g)$ the volume of $(M, g)$. Considering the scale-invariant quantity $λ_{k}(g)\mbox{Vol}(M,g)^{2/n}$ as a functional over all the metrics in a fixed conformal class, we derive a second variation formula for the functional. As a corollary, we prove that if the canonical flat metric on a torus is such that the multiplicity of $λ_{1}$ is two, then the flat metric is not a maximal point of the functional in its conformal class.…
